hosted_harness.notes: Registry publish returned status=published for dh0h/launch-guard@0.1.0.

post_publish_dogfood.command: runx skill dh0h/launch-guard@0.1.0 --registry https://api.runx.ai --input-json release_candidate=<release_go fixture> --input-json launch_policy=<release_go fixture> --json

semantic_checks.summary: release_go emits decision.status go, readiness_report with zero blockers, and release_proposal with version, diff_ref, consumed_by release, and gated true.
blocked_no_go emits decision.status no_go, exact blockers, and release_proposal null.
Every check cites release_candidate.test_results, rollback_plan, observability_plan, changelog, or launch_policy.max_open_risk.
X.yaml declares mutating=false and forbids deployment systems, git tags, package registries, announcement channels, and downstream release execution.
evidence_json.dogfood.harness_cases includes release_go sealed and blocked_no_go refused.
